title: Decision-Focused Learning for Multistage Stochastic Programs, with Application to Power Network Repair Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2611.34419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multistage stochastic programs (MSPs) with discrete decisions are hard to solve due to the curse of dimensionality, non-convex value functions, and scenario trees that grow exponentially with the horizon. We develop a decision-focused learning (DFL) framework for MSPs in which a neural network predicts scores for the part of the decision that drives the state transition. Under structural conditions that make this sub-decision enter the stage objective linearly, the network is trained on labels from offline single-scenario problems, using the Fenchel-Young loss with perturbed optimizers, which need only an optimization oracle. We apply the framework to repair scheduling in power networks under stochastic, time-varying component failures, with and without a per-stage repair budget. translated_title: 面向多阶段随机规划的决策聚焦学习及其在电网修复调度中的应用
translated_abstract: 具有离散决策的多阶段随机规划（MSP）由于维数灾难、非凸值函数以及随时间范围呈指数增长的情景树而难以求解。我们为MSP开发了一个决策聚焦学习（DFL）框架，其中神经网络对驱动状态转移的那部分决策进行得分预测。在使该子决策以线性方式进入阶段目标的结构性条件下，网络通过离线单情景问题的标签进行训练，采用带扰动优化器的Fenchel-Young损失，该方法只需一个优化预言机。我们将该框架应用于随机、时变组件故障下的电网修复调度问题，涵盖有和没有每阶段修复预算两种情形。在合成的5节点网络以及两种修复成本规模下的IEEE 14节点网络上，对学习到的策略与基线策略在常见评估指标上进行了比较。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向多阶段随机规划的决策聚焦学习框架，利用神经网络预测驱动状态转移的决策得分，并通过带扰动优化器的Fenchel-Young损失进行训练，成功应用于随机故障下的电网修复调度问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decision-focused learning framework for multistage stochastic programs, in which a neural network predicts scores for state-transition-driving decisions trained via Fenchel-Young losses with perturbed optimizers, and applies it to power network repair scheduling under stochastic failures.
